releaseNotes:
## Guest Inbox
- Edit any of a contact's listed bookings or inquiries directly beside the email. Saving keeps the email open so you can edit the next stay.

## Schedule and Notes
- Monthly notes and calendar events appear as Schedule in monthly, weekly and daily planning.
- New weekly Notes stay in the weekly view, keeping the calendar clear of everyday reminders. Existing notes remain shared.
- Updated mobile weekly planning and print layout to show Schedule above Notes.

## Fixes
- Note editors reset cleanly when opened or switched to another date or note, while preserving drafts during list refreshes.
